explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. A case-insensitive search of Mathlib for "residue theorem", "windingNumber" and "CauchyPrincipal" turned up only one file, Topology/Covering/FundamentalGroupCircle.lean, which is unrelated. So this Mathlib version has no residue theorem and no notion of contour winding number or Cauchy principal value. The theorem is a corollary of the library's own `hungerbuhlerWasem_residueTheorem`, and its other dependencies are also the library's own definitions (`HasCauchyPV`, `windingNumber`, `IsNullHomologous`, `residue`) and lemmas (`conditionAprime_of_simple_poles`, `conditionB_of_simple_poles`).
